target.title: fix(media): OpenShell /sandbox media paths rejected, breaking image transfer
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users running **OpenShell-sandboxed** sessions could not transfer media (images, files) and could hit startup failures: outbound media paths such as `/sandbox/out/photo.png` were rejected with `Path escapes sandbox root`, because core media normalization hardcoded the container working directory as `/workspace`.

Closes #98446.

## Why This Change Was Made

`@openclaw/openshell-sandbox` only permits `remoteWorkspaceDir` under `/sandbox` or `/agent` (a security contract — left unchanged), but core media normalization hardcoded `SANDBOX_CONTAINER_WORKDIR = "/workspace"`, so any `/sandbox/...` media path failed the prefix check.

The fix threads the **active sandbox `containerWorkdir`** through outbound media path normalization on the core/media side, reusing the `sandboxContainerWorkdir` plumbing that already exists for the nodes-workspace-guard (populated in `SandboxWorkspaceInfo`, sourced from `sandbox.containerWorkdir`) — it was simply not wired into the message/media tool path.

- `resolveSandboxedMediaSource` / `mapContainerWorkspacePath` / `mapContainerWorkspaceFileUrl` accept an optional `containerWorkdir` (default `/workspace`, trailing slashes normalized, prefix-attack-safe).
- Threaded through `createReplyMediaPathNormalizer` and `createMessageTool → runMessageAction → normalizeSandboxMediaList / resolveAttachmentMediaPolicy`.
- `containerWorkdir` is optional everywhere and defaults to `/workspace`, so all existing `/workspace` (Docker) callers and tests are unchanged.

## User Impact

OpenShell-sandboxed sessions can now send and receive media without the path being rejected, and no longer break on startup over the workspace-path mismatch. Default Docker `/workspace` sandbox behavior is unchanged.

## Evidence

Focused vitest (local, Node 24):
- `src/agents/sandbox-paths.test.ts` — **42 passed**, incl. new coverage: `/sandbox` → sandbox-root mapping, `file:///sandbox/...` mapping, default `/workspace` preserved, trailing-slash normalization (`/sandbox/` ≡ `/sandbox`), **prefix-attack rejection** (`/sandboxer/secret` rejected), `/workspace` rejection when `containerWorkdir=/sandbox`, and root-only `containerWorkdir="/"` falls back to default (no empty-prefix over-match).
- `src/infra/outbound/message-action-params.test.ts` — **24 passed | 11 skipped** (3 new tests run and pass; skips are pre-existing `maybeIt()` Windows guards).
- `src/auto-reply/reply/reply-media-paths.test.ts` — new test covers OpenShell `containerWorkdir="/sandbox"` reply media resolving into the sandbox root.
- `tsgo` core typecheck: exit 0. `oxlint` on all touched files: exit 0.

Note: `reply-media-paths.test.ts` shows pre-existing Windows-only failures (the shared `beforeEach` mock uses `path.join("/tmp/...")` → backslashes on win32 vs forward-slash expectations); CI truth is Linux Node 24 where these pass. Verified pre-existing by stashing the change (base branch has the same failures; the new test follows the identical pattern and passes on Linux).

This is a pure in-process path-normalization fix (string prefix matching), so unit tests directly exercise the behavior — no provider/container live run is required.

## Relation to existing PRs

#98474 takes the same correct approach (core-side threading, plugin contract untouched) but has a **dirty merge conflict** against current `main` (main evolved the `sandboxContainerWorkdir` plumbing for the nodes-workspace-guard since it was authored) and **ships no tests**. This PR rebases the approach onto current `main` by reusing the already-present `sandboxContainerWorkdir` option (resolving the conflict at the source) and adds the regression tests covering prefix-attack, trailing-slash, default-fallback, and the root-only edge case.
